routes.owner: GThread recorded by BindingStore construction; GUI adapters install on UI thread
operations: construct, register, initialize, activate, const read, mutation, close, generation checks on creator thread
ObjectRef/WeakRef retain/copy/lock/release follow referred-object affinity; find is lookup only
routes.boundary: Context acquisition does not change creator identity; synchronous creator-thread operation does not require current context ownership
routes.close_and_final_release: Owner final-unrefs; off-thread BindingStore destruction diagnoses then cleans synchronously, not marshalled recovery

routes.owner: Creating owner thread and explicitly attached context
operations: Source create/replace/close and affinity-bearing callable destruction on owner
FairDispatcher ticket creation/schedule/cancel/destruction and deque access owner-confined
routes.boundary: Source runs on context iterating thread; no marshalling or affinity guard. FairDispatcher enqueue checks thread, dispatch/cancel rely on contract
routes.close_and_final_release: Source pins executing callable during self-close; destroying on owner preserves capture affinity

operations: prepare dependencies and native context
sample lower-stack graph into owned packed bytes
import private staging buffer and publish current completed generation
emit progress/state notifications after reading plain channel snapshot
routes.boundary: Read/Import/Commit/Gate callables are ephemeral synchronous owner callbacks passed to FilterScheduler::step; never in Request/Job
routes.close_and_final_release: FilterImpl closes scheduler, tickets, connections, native context and refs on owner without join

operations: compute with owned Job input/output, scalar options and approved plain-value Process captures
write success/error/output, then release-store done
routes.boundary: Owner acquires done before reading non-atomic worker output; generation check rejects stale completion; Process capture graph must exclude UI/Gimp/BindingStore ownership
routes.close_and_final_release: Job/Process destruction can occur on either side; owner close drops its share, worker later destroys independent state and lifetime token

routes.owner: Independent std::thread; TemporaryFilterRaster tied to constructing worker
operations: own temporary files, quotas, process handles, profile and scratch
SPSC transfer of uniquely owned chunks
run process only after acquired input seal
routes.boundary: Owner may fill shared native descriptor/options during collection, completes before_process, then seals; no mutation after seal until prior worker completion. Progress uses mutex/try_snapshot; result uses release/acquire atomic scalar
routes.close_and_final_release: Worker closes files before complete/done publication; admission/lifetime leases outlive resources. Cancellation is a request, not completion

routes.owner: Main thread of separate gimp-painter-filter-worker process
operations: construct PrivateRuntime and local Gimp/PDB/image/layer/buffer/progress objects
service own default context for native plugin watches
separate lifeline thread only reads pipe and kills process group
routes.boundary: Only validated scalar/byte wire frames cross process boundary; no parent GUI object crosses
routes.close_and_final_release: PrivateRuntime drains plugins and releases local GIMP/GEGL on helper main before terminal success; parent validates terminal/EOF/reap/cleanup

routes.owner: GUI owner, cooperatively scheduled default-context idle
operations: capture settings/color/resources synchronously
duplicate private GimpBrush/GimpPattern; own GeglBuffer and GdkPixbuf
step bounded preview samples and publish complete current revision
routes.boundary: Weak owner + store generation + preview revision guard; PreviewJob is not a detached worker and GObject snapshots are not transferable plain values
routes.close_and_final_release: Owner cancels/replaces/closes Source, PreviewJob and resource refs; running step pins current job across reentry

routes.owner: GUI owner; MyPaint ColorTool synchronous Session; Fill/Smudge default-context idle
operations: MyPaint Session/PaintCore operate synchronously from custom input callbacks
Fill/Smudge freeze GObject-bearing stroke options/resources and drain bounded owner work
Undo, GEGL native resources and notifications stay in owner transaction
routes.boundary: Async/queued names do not imply detached execution; custom tool callbacks override native input and use owner weak/generation validation
routes.close_and_final_release: Owner cancels/finishes sessions/strokes, closes sources and releases GObject refs

routes.owner: Existing native GimpPaintTool paint thread and owner transaction
operations: paint worker interpolates against borrowed live native paint tool/core/options/drawables under native paint_mutex
BrushCore invokes Painter geometry, texturize and compatibility paper paste on native buffers/caches
routes.boundary: Upstream paint queue, paint_mutex, owner flush and PAINT_FINISH lifecycle apply; exception does not permit custom BindingStore or GTK usage from a Filter worker
routes.close_and_final_release: Native paint-end drains queued PAINT_FINISH before native finish/cancel/end-paint; BrushCore owns retained texture/cache lifetime. This audit identifies route, not complete concurrent-edit race safety

limits: Source is not an affinity marshaller; owner-context discipline is required
Final release follows caller thread; owning UI references must not reach worker captures
Request descriptors freeze after owner preparation/seal, not allocation
Native synchronized paint exception does not permit arbitrary GObject or GTK worker operations
No production race defect or universal race-freedom demonstrated; LSan/TSan and platform gates not passed
